people.name: Eli
people.line: High priest and judge of Israel at Shiloh

translations.web: Now the sons of Eli were wicked men. They didn’t know Yahweh.
translations.bsb: Now the sons of Eli were wicked men; they had no regard for the LORD
translations.kjv: Now the sons of Eli were sons of Belial; they knew not the LORD.
translations.asv: Now the sons of Eli were base men; they knew not Jehovah.
